error_signature: Write failures due to disk usage at 98%
scenario_description: logging-service ki disk usage 98% pe pohanch gayi hai, log writes fail ho rahe hain. Koi recent deployment nahi, lekin log retention/cleanup job kaafi din se disabled tha.

ground_truth.likely_cause: log rotation/cleanup job was disabled weeks ago, causing gradual disk fill-up
ground_truth.correct_action: manually clear old logs immediately, then re-enable the log rotation job
